sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after a change of source, a change of material or a change of manufacturing process.

A change of coating or surface treatment within the same specification family requires
notification to Aurelia at least 60 days before implementation; approval is not required.

no change to an
approved part or its process may be implemented without the written approval of Aurelia.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, whose customer is Aurelia. The drawing coating is clear anodising (COAT-ANOD). The proposal replaces it with a trivalent conversion coating (COAT-TCP). That is a different process, not a variant within one specification family, so CSR-AUR-R3 7.1 and contract clause 14.3 require written Aurelia approval before shipment. Even if it were read as a coating change within one family, 7.2 would still require notification at least 60 days ahead. No approval or notification in force covers it. The documents do not include CSR-AUR-R4, which Aurelia also imposes.
